name: inherits group grants and strengthens them on descendants
input: a root group grant and a child user grant
test:
permissions = PagePermissions()
permissions.add_page('root')
permissions.add_page('child', 'root')
permissions.add_page('leaf', 'child')
permissions.add_user_to_group('ben', 'readers')
permissions.grant_group('root', 'readers', 'view')
permissions.grant_user('child', 'ada', 'edit')
assert permissions.getUserPermissionForPage('leaf', 'ben') == 'view'
assert permissions.getUserPermissionForPage('leaf', 'ada') == 'edit'

name: combines groups and returns sorted users meeting a threshold
input: users with view, comment, and edit grants
test:
permissions = PagePermissions()
permissions.add_page('page')
permissions.add_user_to_group('zoe', 'writers')
permissions.add_user_to_group('ada', 'writers')
permissions.grant_group('page', 'writers', 'comment')
permissions.grant_user('page', 'ben', 'view')
permissions.grant_user('page', 'ada', 'edit')
assert permissions.getAllUsersWithPermissionForPage('page') == ['ada', 'ben', 'zoe']
assert permissions.getAllUsersWithPermissionForPage('page', 'comment') == ['ada', 'zoe']
